cost: With V endpoints and E stored edges, path is O(V+E), add one path plus append; kill O(E). closure iterates at most V+2 rounds, scanning live edges and cloning V/64-word rows: O(V E ceil(V/64)) time and O(V ceil(V/64)) result memory. Dead edges still occupy adjacency storage. known_since scans K knowledge and R reveals. creation_order costs up to 64 scans of N candidates with ordered-set lookup and entity snapshot work.
description: State is (point identity map, world ids, live tagged edges, frames, canonical metadata, knowledge and reveals). add accepts u<=v or u<v exactly when a return path does not form a strict cycle; equal-node weak insertion is a no-op. path prefers any strict witness. order is an ordered classifier of endpoint reachability, not a complete Allen algebra. known_since takes the first minimum sentence among explicit knowledge, reveals, telling, listeners and narrator opening. creation_order orders six supported registries with bounded dependency passes.

Time, frame, observer and reproduction fragments share Id/Pt identity. narr::register creates endpoints and metadata; narr::relate inserts endpoint constraints; World::apply supplies outer rollback. Frame worlds and canonical metadata must agree on wid. Knowledge sentence time is independent of story endpoint order.
inverse: Within the add-generated graph universe, transitions accepting a strict return cycle are absent. With missing event endpoints order cannot certify any relation. Different start-node world ids preclude all order labels except OtherWorld. These exclusions do not promise that raw add rejects cross-world edges.

Given only order(a,b), retain every valid graph whose prioritized classifier returns that label. The fiber discards edge provenance, redundant paths, other nodes and absolute chronology. For the acyclic strict three-edge family (0,1),(1,2),(0,2), reach(0,2)=strict has exactly masks 3,4,5,6,7; enumeration is complete only on those eight candidates.
limitations: Partial source models and bounded synthetic tests; no universal coverage.
Parent acyclicity, valid typed variants and sufficient resources are premises; arbitrary mutable state corruption and panic rollback are unmodeled.
No live parser, corpus, training, persistence, GPU or throughput evidence.
state: On graphs constructed through add, no live cycle contains a strict edge. Pt identity reuses its first world id; callers must maintain same-world edge premises. A public Order is a projection of constraints, not their converse. Stack and parent acyclicity are established by narrative commands, not validated by recursive narr_level.
